scenarios.title: Created habitat — difficulty when created in advance
scenarios.description: Six parcels created in advance, testing the metric's difficulty rules (BMD-1041). H001: Reservoirs, Moderate (5 years to target, 1 to Poor), 4 years in advance — short of the target, so Medium (×0.67); counting the advance twice gives Low. H002: the same with 5 years — the target is reached, so Low (×1). H003–H006: four of the habitats exempt from the switch to enhancement difficulty — Ponds (non-priority habitat), Ornamental lake or pond, Ruderal/Ephemeral and Tall forbs — each created to Good (5 years, 1 to Poor) 2 years in advance. Each keeps its Low creation difficulty (×1); without the exemption H003, H005 and H006 get Medium (×0.67) and H004 High (×0.33). The other two exempt habitats are left out: Traditional orchards is High distinctiveness, outside the service's scope, and Developed land; sealed surface has Low creation and enhancement difficulty, so the exemption changes nothing.
